name: Shadow of the Moonlight
source:
You are the privileged son of a wealthy family.
But your life is torn apart, and you cannot remain who you were.
Revenge against the enemies is the only thing that makes sense now…
even if it means becoming an outlaw.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3967330/Shadow_of_the_Moonlight/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你是一个富裕家庭的特权子弟。
但你的生活已经支离破碎，你无法保持原来的样子。
现在唯一有意义的事情就是向敌人报仇……
即使这意味着成为亡命之徒。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3967330/Shadow_of_the_Moonlight/]Steam[/url]]
